title: Staff Backend Engineer
content: <div><p>Welcome to Acme Global &amp; Partners! We are leading the industry &mdash; providing top-tier solutions.</p><h3>Location &amp; Eligibility</h3><p>Candidates must reside in the EU.</p><p>Location: Remote (US only).</p><p>We require valid work authorization in your country of residence.</p><p>Core team hours are aligned with CET timezone.</p><p>Applicants based in the UK or Germany are preferred.</p><p>Unfortunately we cannot sponsor work permit or visa applications at this time.</p><p>Eligible candidates will be contacted for an initial screening.</p><p>Must live within +/- 3 hours of EST.</p><h3>About the Team</h3><p>We respect &quot;clean code&quot; and engineering craftsmanship. Here's what you need to know about our values:</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>7+ years in backend development &amp; distributed architectures</li><li>Deep knowledge of HTTP, TCP/IP, and cloud services (AWS or GCP)</li><li>Experience with database optimization &amp; caching layers</li></ul><h3>Detailed Background and Projects Overview</h3><p>This role involves working across multiple engineering teams and distributed systems. Our technical environment encompasses hundreds of microservices processing billions of requests weekly. You will collaborate closely with product management, site reliability engineering, and data platform teams to architect resilient systems. Scalability is at the core of everything we do at Acme Global. In this role, you will be expected to drive architectural reviews, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conduct post-mortems without blame, and continuously raise the engineering bar across the organization. Our tech stack is primarily built on Node.js, TypeScript, Go, and PostgreSQL, deployed via Kubernetes clusters managed across multiple cloud regions with high availability guarantees.</p><p>Every engineer at Acme Global contributes directly to product direction and technical roadmap planning. We avoid top-down mandates in favor of data-driven decisions and peer review. We conduct bi-weekly sprint planning and retrospectives, maintaining high transparency with open design documents and collaborative RFC processes. As a Staff Engineer, your influence extends beyond single teams to organizational architecture patterns, cross-cutting security initiatives, and performance optimization across the entire application lifecycle. You will have dedicated time for exploratory engineering, architecture prototypes, and technical debt reduction initiatives. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive, thoughtful environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated and valued.</p><p>Our engineers enjoy significant autonomy and flexible schedules. Whether you are refactoring core transaction processing pipelines, designing event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka, or hardening authentication mechanisms, you will have the tools and support needed to produce world-class software. We encourage contributions to open source projects and provide educational stipends for attending conferences, purchasing technical books, or taking specialized training courses. Our teams regularly publish engineering blog posts and give talks at major tech events. If you are passionate about building robust software, solving challenging concurrency problems, and mentoring the next generation of engineers, Acme Global is the place for you.</p><p>Additional responsibilities include leading technical incident response during major outages, participating in the on-call rotation with fair compensation and sustainable scheduling, evaluating third-party vendor solutions, and collaborating with compliance teams to maintain strict security certifications including SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. You will also take part in interview loops to help us identify and hire exceptional talent. We believe in continuous learning, iterative improvement, and fostering a culture of psychological safety where team members feel confident taking calculated risks and learning from failures.</p><p>Furthermore, as our global footprint expands, you will help design data residency solutions ensuring compliance with regional privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA. You will work on cross-region data replication, disaster recovery strategies, and zero-downtime deployment pipelines that allow our teams to ship dozens of updates daily with complete confidence and zero service disruption to our global customer base. We maintain comprehensive automated test suites including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that run on every pull request, giving engineers rapid feedback and preventing regressions from reaching production environments.</p><p>Looking ahead over the coming years, Acme Global is undertaking substantial modernization of our core persistence and telemetry infrastructure. We are actively investigating stream processing models that can process events with sub-millisecond latencies, exploring rust-based micro-daemons for edge routing, and transitioning legacy batch analytical workloads into continuous streaming datasets. The candidate selected for this position will spearhead technical design discussions, author foundational RFCs, establish benchmark criteria against rigorous latency percentiles (p99 and p99.9), and coordinate cross-team migration timelines without downtime or data degradation. Your technical leadership will be pivotal in maintaining our reputation for unparalleled reliability and unmatched system throughput.</p><h3>Perks &amp; Benefits</h3><ul><li>Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with zero employee premium</li><li>401(k) retirement plan with immediate 5% employer match</li><li>Generous parental leave for all new parents (birthing and non-birthing)</li><li>Annual $3,000 continuous education and learning budget</li><li>Home office setup stipend of $1,500 plus top-of-the-line laptop and accessories</li></ul></div>
